deviations.what: c1/O2a 'Phone · +91 fixed' and c1b/L2 'Sign in · your number' subtitles: body copy draws with Material's inherited tracking at 16 px where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked, so lines break a word or two earlier than the frame

No token defines tracking and RkType.body sets none, so ThemeData merges the M3 defaults (bodyLarge 0.5 px, bodyMedium 0.25 px); one line in rkTextTheme (letterSpacing: 0) fixes every screen. 15.5 px maps to the body role (16) by rule
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme (phase 2 shared component); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens decide values: typography.scale.body 16)

deviations.authority: design-system.md §3.1 rule 9 🔒 (target ≥ 44 pt); 13 §8 (touch targets ≥ 44 dp); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (a frame never overrides accessibility)
